float_vs_gnuradio.rationale: GNU Radio's volk atan2 is a polynomial; measured worst 0.066 LSB = 2e-6 rad times the gain 2; bound allows 3e-5 rad on other volk kernels

fixed_vs_float.rationale: CORDIC with 16 iterations leaves a residual angle below atan(2^-15) = 3.05e-5 rad; times gain 2 = 6.1e-5 = 2.0 LSB, plus 0.5 LSB output rounding and the Q15 product rounding of the guard bits (measured 2.5 LSB, 78.2 dB)
Same CORDIC residual (2.0 LSB at gain 2) in the 18 bit format, plus 0.1 LSB rounding; the iteration count, not the format, limits it (measured 2.1 LSB, 78.5 dB; 20 iterations are tested separately)
